Bash(cd "D:/knowledgebase/Bruce's Vault/Areas/语言/古希腊语/笔记/Introduction to Attic Greek"
echo "=== 导航页 Unit 8-10 行 ==="
sed -n '16,18p' "Introduction to Attic Greek - D. J. Mastronarde.md"
echo ""
echo "=== 每个笔记/练习的 上一篇/下一篇 链完整性 ==="
for n in 9 10; do
  for kind in 笔记 练习; do
    f="Introduction to Attic Greek - Unit $n $kind.md"
    echo "--- Unit $n $kind ---"
    grep -oE '\\[\\[Introduction to Attic Greek - Unit [0-9]+ \(笔记|练习\)\\|\(上一篇|下一篇\)\\]\\]' "$f" | sed 's/\\|.*//;s/\\[\\[//' | while read t; do
      [ -e "$t.md" ] && echo "OK   -> $t" || echo "BROKEN -> $t"
    done
  done
done)
